title: Homogeneity of the product moment norm
statement: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses, and let $\Omega=\prod_{i=0}^{n-1}\Omega_i$ be its outcome space. For every $q>0$, every $a\ge0$, and every function $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, the product moment norm satisfies $\|af\|_{q,P}=a\|f\|_{q,P}$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a product of $n$ finite probability spaces
Every atom mass is strictly positive and each coordinate's masses sum to one
replaced: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses and outcome space $\Omega=\prod_i\Omega_i$, $q>0$, $a\ge0$, and $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Then $\|af\|_{q,P}=a\|f\|_{q,P}$.
